retune.description:
An open-source youtube music client , forked from Muzza from Maloy Begonia 

Features
- Play songs from YT/YT Music without ads

- YouTube-Music synchronization

- Importing from Spotify

- Background playback

- Search songs, videos, albums, and playlists from YouTube Music

- Login support

- Cache and download songs for offline playback

- Synchronized lyrics

- Lyrics translator

- Skip silence

- Audio normalization

- Adjust tempo/pitch

- Dynamic theme

- Android Auto support

- Personalized quick picks

Credits
ReTune is a fork based on the work of:

- InnerTune

- OuterTune

- Metrolist

- OpenTune

- Muzza

            Remixed by JNTX Studio.
